meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude 会在无真实终端的 pty 里跑起引擎应用,记录它输出的每一帧,把你的输入叠加进去编码成视频,最后生成一个含视频、可点击时间线、检查表和快照的 summary 页面并打开它。
howto.when: 当你需要验证引擎应用的行为(如渲染、点击、滚动),而不是写只导出 PNG 的一次性 pty 脚本时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我验证滚轮平移时鼠标位置是否保持不动
say.note: 会录制整段过程并生成 summary 页面

say.text: 验证打字输入后画面有没有重绘,并给出检查结果
say.note: summary 里会列出每个检查的通过或失败

say.text: 跑一次验证,结束后把 summary 页面打开给我看
say.note: 输出 run 目录路径和 summary 路径

howto.what_en: Claude runs your engine app headlessly in a pty, records every frame it emits, overlays your inputs, encodes a video, and writes a summary page with the video, a clickable timeline, checks and stills, then opens it.
howto.when_en: Use it to verify an engine app's behavior — rendering, clicks, scrolling — instead of hand-rolling one-off pty scripts that only dump PNGs.

say_en.text: Verify that wheel pan keeps the cursor anchored
say_en.note: Records the run and builds a summary page

say_en.text: Check whether typing into the editor redraws
say_en.note: Pass/fail rows appear in the summary

say_en.text: Run a verification and open the summary for me
say_en.note: Prints the run dir and summary path
